themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Surge
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked to 4 reports THIS WEEK, a 357% increase versus the 0.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting a potential public health and sanitation crisis in Brownsville/Ocean Hill.
evidence: 4 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average (357% spike, z-score: 3.37)
Spike emerged suddenly this week with no prior escalation signal
Convergence with concurrent rodent spike (16 complaints this week, 228% above baseline) suggests broader pest/animal control failure
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about emergency response protocols and whether crews are overwhelmed
Document specific locations and duration complaints remain unresolved; canvass residents for health concerns

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Acceleration
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints jumped to 16 reports THIS WEEK, a 228% spike over the 4.9 weekly baseline, indicating a potential pest control emergency coinciding with the dead animal surge.
evidence: 16 rodent complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.9 weekly average (228% spike, z-score: 2.75)
Spike is acute and emerged this week without sustained prior trend
Paired with dead animal surge suggests systemic sanitation or vector control breakdown
reporting_angles: Interview residents about infestations in homes, schools, or businesses; assess whether complaints are clustered geographically
Request DSNY/DOH response: What triggered the spike? Are poison/trap deployments adequate?

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints reached 6 reports THIS WEEK, a 200% increase from the 2.0 weekly average, suggesting rapid illegal dispensary proliferation or compliance issues in the district.
evidence: 6 cannabis retailer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.0 weekly average (200% spike, z-score: 2.67)
Spike emerged acutely this week with no prior escalation
May reflect illegal unlicensed dispensaries or licensed retailer neighbor complaints
reporting_angles: Map the 6 complaints to specific addresses; determine if they target unlicensed dispensaries or licensed retailers violating terms
Interview CB16 and local Council member on enforcement strategy and whether state OCM oversight is sufficient

themes_detail.label: Vehicle Noise Spike
themes_detail.summary: Vehicle noise complaints jumped to 13 reports last week, a 236% increase versus the 3.9 weekly average, representing a sharp one-week escalation in traffic-related disturbances.
evidence: 13 vehicle noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.9 weekly average (236% spike, z-score: 3.07)
Spike is recent (last week) and not sustained from prior periods
Complements broader noise spike: residential noise also up 38% (158 complaints 2 weeks ago vs 114.1 avg)
reporting_angles: Canvass neighborhoods for specifics: illegal drag racing, commercial truck traffic, or modified exhaust vehicles?
Check NYPD enforcement logs for traffic stops or noise violations issued in the past 2 weeks

themes_detail.label: Street Sign Disappearance
themes_detail.summary: Missing street sign complaints exploded to 3 reports 2 weeks ago, a 700% spike from the 0.4 weekly baseline, suggesting either systematic theft or prolonged DSNY maintenance failures.
evidence: 3 missing street sign complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 5.42, highest z-score in dataset)
Spike appeared 2 weeks ago; unclear if sustained or resolved
Could indicate scrap metal theft targeting municipal signage or inventory depletion from recent construction activity (423 DOB permits filed)
reporting_angles: Visit the 3 complaint locations; determine if signs are still missing or have been replaced
Interview DSNY about maintenance backlog and whether metal theft is a known problem in the district
